name: OPIM 5114
title: Sustainable Supply Chain Management: Strategies for Environmental and Social Responsibility
description: Supply chain sustainability has gained significant importance in today's globalized and interconnected world. This course provides a comprehensive understanding of sustainable supply chain management. It equips students with the knowledge and tools to develop strategies for achieving environmental and social responsibility in supply chain operations. Students will explore the critical role of supply chains in addressing global sustainability challenges, such as climate change, resource scarcity, human rights, and fair labor practices. This course aims to empower students to create positive change in supply chains, drive innovation, and promote long-term economic, environmental, and social value through a combination of theoretical concepts, practical case studies, and interactive discussions.
requirement_description: Open to all School of Business graduate students.
